challenge_topics.title: Design Requirements and Compliance Checks
challenge_topics.description: Use of AI/Large Language Model (LLM) such as ChatGPT/Bard Gemini AI to compare project requirements with regulatory standards and identify non-compliance issues, flagging any discrepancies for human review.

challenge_topics.title: Design Creation
challenge_topics.description: Use of Generative AI to automate design options and architectural visualisation, e.g., generating a range of choices and recommending best design options based on user-defined project parameters; detailed and accurate visual representation of designs through real-time sketch inputs. Use of LLM to generate codes that automate design options, by providing a range of viable options based on specified criteria such as size, efficiency, unit-mix, etc.

challenge_topics.title: Data-Driven Sustainability and Buildability
challenge_topics.description: Based on project design requirements alongside AI to automate Green Mark and Buildability Scores, taking into account factors like energy efficiency and material use.

challenge_topics.title: Performance Analysis and Optimisation
challenge_topics.description: Using AI software for more accurate cost estimation by allowing AI to learn from past similar projects and provide more precise estimates for new projects, thus keeping all stakeholders updated to ensure efficient coordination.

challenge_topics.title: Design Collaboration and Coordination
challenge_topics.description: Using AI with a data management platform for data and information linkage, indexing and tracking.

challenge_topics.title: Design and Tender Documentation
challenge_topics.description: Use of AI for Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfMA) planning optimisation, maximizing modular building components and reducing coordination time and construction costs.
